notes.title: Friendly Fire Mechanic!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681054/d5f4e9780f7310d78dc804cff3e67ead15044432.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Friendly Fire Mechanic: Introducing the Friendly Fire mechanic (can turn on/off), where players must tread carefully to avoid inadvertently harming one another. Team coordination and strategic positioning have never been more crucial. Will you rise as a cohesive unit or succumb to the chaos of indiscriminate strikes?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681054/a2f02d7621564e80a8c034868d47941c93cb5522.png[/img]
[*] Camera Sensitivity Error Fixed: No longer shall your perspective be tethered, for the chains restricting your ability to rotate the camera have been shattered
[/list]

notes.title: DLC Release and Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
[b]DLC Call Of The Haunted Released![/b]
And more:

[h2]Gameplay improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ability to dodge after attack damage phase has already ended
[*]Enemy walk backwards slowly
[*]Sounds of body damage on attacks
[*]Camera shake when attacking or taking damage
[*]Changed dodge attack
[/list]
[h2]
Experience improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Graphics and home menu usability improvements
[*]Home menu with music
[*]Background loading of data during the initial menu, reducing the time of the first Loading
[*]Separate loading of Castle, Prison and Graveyard
[/list]

notes.title: Health potion, improved moves, new attacks, smarter NPCs and more
notes.content:
[h2]Health potion, improved moves, new attacks, smarter NPCs and more[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681054/f3e7ee9a6859453b4b867544a0b44c7a2a54ab10.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Improvement in the combat experience: Added movement to the attacks, bringing greater immersion to the combat.
[*] New attack movements.
[*] Some NPCS now have more than 2 attacks.
[*] Improvement in the behavior of allied NPCs when attacking: now they autonomously attack enemies that are nearby.
[*] NPCs can also use items.
[*] Modified keyboard controls: now to aim at an enemy, the middle mouse button is used, for strong attack, use the 'E' key, and to open the inventory of a friendly NPC, look at it, and hold the middle mouse button.
[*] Improvement in some character animations, such as lateral movement and parry animation.
[*] (beta) Difficulty selector (access through options)
[*] Made some other visual and environmental improvements, like text fonts.
[/list]
